name: SaltyShrimp Bee Shrimp Mineral GH+
description: Remineralizer for soft-water (Caridina / bee) shrimp tanks — raises GH while leaving KH near zero, for the soft acidic water bee shrimp need. The per-gram dGH is dialled to a target GH rather than published as a fixed delta, so values are NOT disclosed.
notes: Dose to a target GH with a TDS / GH test (community guidance ~0.15-0.2 g/L for 5-6 dGH); the manufacturer specifies a target rather than a fixed per-gram ppm. Raises GH only — pairs with active soil for Caridina.
